name: buddydock
description: Restyle macOS Dock icons with Effect and fal.ai

scripts.build:native: mkdir -p dist && swiftc -O native/DockInspector.swift -o dist/buddydock-inspector && swiftc -O native/Squircle.swift -o dist/buddydock-squircle && swiftc -O native/DockApplier.swift -o dist/buddydock-applier
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun run build:native && bun run build:cli && bun run build:app
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.build:app: APP=dist/BuddyDock.app/Contents && mkdir -p $APP/MacOS $APP/Resources && bun build src/cli.ts --compile --outfile $APP/MacOS/BuddyDock && cp dist/buddydock-inspector dist/buddydock-applier dist/buddydock-squircle $APP/MacOS/ && cp native/Info.plist $APP/Info.plist && codesign --force --sign - --identifier ai.buddydock.cli dist/BuddyDock.app
